subject: Prospect requests demo standby due to Q2 sprint siphon
messages:
From: Evan Morales <evan.morales@bluearc.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.s@bluearc.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — quick update

Hi Soojin,

Wanted to surface a change on our side — our product org just pulled a couple engineers into an emergency sprint to address a performance regression for an upcoming customer pilot. That team owns the integration work we planned to demo, and they
re being reassigned for the next 6 weeks.

Given that, the momentum for the Redwood pilot is going to stall. Can we put our demo on standby for now? We still like to proceed at some point — ideally after their sprint (targeting mid-June) — but we need to free up the calendar and reprioritize a few things internally.

I know this is not ideal — apologies for the churn. If helpful, I can share a short note outlining the re-prioritization so your team has context for re-engagement. Also cc Priya (product) who be the right technical owner once the team is back.

Thanks,
Evan Morales
VP Product
BlueArc Systems
attachments: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Morales <evan.morales@bluearc.ai>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.s@bluearc.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — quick update

Thanks for the heads up, Evan — appreciate the transparency.

Totally understand the need to reassign for the sprint. We can absolutely park the demo for now and pick back up after your team is free. Quick next steps from my side:
- I mark the deal as On hold in our CRM and set a reminder to reach out the week of June 14 to check availability.
- If you like, we can schedule a short technical office hours slot (30 min) for your team while they be on the sprint so they can ask architecture questions without needing a full demo.
- I also send an updated one-page SOW draft and the demo agenda (attached) so you have materials to share with stakeholders.

Would mid-June work as a tentative reconnect? If you prefer we reevaluate in early July, we can do that instead.

I loop in Aditya (sales lead) and Marissa (CS) for awareness so we can align follow-up cadence.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198
attachments: SOW-draft-v1.pdf

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Redwood demo — quick update (BlueArc)

Aditya / Marissa — forwarding Evan s note below. BlueArc just pulled engineers into a high-priority product sprint and asked us to pause the demo. Quick context and recommended plan: 

Context:
- Prospect: BlueArc Systems, VP Product Evan Morales + Priya (product).
- Reason: engineering capacity reallocated to a regression fix/customer pilot; estimated 6 weeks.
- Impact: demo and integration work will be delayed; procurement/PO conversations will likely follow the product sprint.

Recommended next actions:
1) Mark deal RDW-4521 On hold in HubSpot with reason "Prospect sprint reprioritization" and set a follow-up task for week of 2027-06-14. HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/4521
2) Offer a 30-min technical office hours session while they re in sprint (optional) — low friction touch to keep technical rapport.
3) Share the SOW draft and demo agenda now so internal stakeholders have materials (attached).
4) Nurture cadence: check-in 2 weeks after sprint ends, then monthly until they re-open the effort.

I recommend we avoid escalating discounts or credits immediately — this feels like a normal product priority shift. If procurement pushes earlier, we can re-evaluate.

Marissa: would you be OK owning the post-sprint re-engage (tech touch + kickoff once they reallocate)? Aditya: flagging for forecasting if this deal moves to Q3.

Thanks,
Soojin

From: Evan Morales <evan.morales@bluearc.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.s@bluearc.ai>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — quick update

On Thu, May 6, 2027 at 10:14 AM Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks for the heads up, Evan — appreciate the transparency.
> 
> Totally understand the need to reassign for the sprint. We can absolutely park the demo for now and pick back up after your team is free.

Thanks, Soojin — appreciate the quick flexibility. Mid-June tentative reconnect works for us; please go ahead and set a reminder for the week of June 14.

We ll take the office hours offer — Priya will send a preferred 30-min window for the week of May 24 (tight but doable) so the tech lead can ask two quick integration questions.

I ll also attach a short internal note for context that you can use when you follow up.

Best,
Evan
